data.one_liner: Provides Dart models for many color spaces and conversion between them.
data.what_it_does: Defines classes for CMYK, HSI, HSL, HSP, HSB, LAB, Oklab, RGB, and XYZ color spaces. Includes methods to convert, adjust, interpolate, and augment colors.
use_when: You need precise color manipulation across multiple color spaces
You want to convert colors without relying on Flutter's Color class
You need utilities for color interpolation and palette generation
avoid_when: You only need basic Flutter Color support
You require a UI widget library for colors
strengths: Wide range of color space support
weaknesses: No Flutter widgets, only data models
May be overkill for simple color needs
